title: Store Git checkout markers outside working trees
body:
By storing an `.ok` file in the Git checkout root, uv can collide with an `.ok` file in the checkout. Store the marker a directory up, `<commit>.ok` instead of `<commit>/.ok`, to avoid potential collisions.

Fixes #21857.
